messages.subject: Packrat fetching fails for local sources
parts:
Hi,

I'm new to Packrat, and I'm trying to make a project so I share it  with others.

the package I put in the local repository is available in Bioconductor but I want the devel version of it. so I installed it with no problem, but then I realized that I need to install its dependencies separately. I figured that out. but now when I do
packrat::init()
 the fetching fails, and it say that it couldn't find source for the new version.  I didn't know that Packrat look for Bioconductor packages as well.

IS there anything that I can do for this?

Thanks a lot
